description: How much of the monthly email quota an organization has used: emails sent this month, emails waiting in the queue, the plan limit (Free 300, Plus 3000, Pro 20000; null means unlimited), whether the plan allows marketing email, and whether sending is paused for the organization (too many bounces or complaints). Covers email sent by automations, the communications endpoints and app servers (POST /apps/<slug>/api/_email/send).
name: get_email_usage
